unit.why: Opens an anecdote about the tsaddik of Radoshitz who, while seriously ill, reflects aloud on what confession he can honestly make; the narrative breaks off mid-sentence.

stories.start_quote: פ״א תלה מאד הרה״צ הקדוש מראדשי' זצללה"ה
stories.summary_en: When the holy tsaddik of Radoshitz was gravely ill, he reflected that he could neither confess to sins he had not committed nor promise to serve God more diligently, since he had already done all he could, and so he resolved only to serve God with purer intention.

quotes: הדרך היא שאדם מתודה בשעת חליו
tags.why: deathbed-style confession and resolution, which the tsaddik examines

quotes: איך יוכל לומר שקר ובאמת לא חטאתי
tags.why: refuses to confess falsely; lying is discussed, not committed
the story's point is the tsaddik's integrity and complete devotion
illustrates the tsaddik's piety and truthfulness
the confession (viduy) as a liturgical act
